summary: Learn drift detection, AI incident response, and performance reporting. Build practical post-deployment monitoring controls; explore the course.
lede: AI model monitoring is the ongoing review of deployed models to track performance and spot changes. For AI product owners, model risk analysts, data scientists, engineers, and assurance professionals, this training covers setting performance baselines and drift thresholds, reviewing data or concept drift, documenting and escalating incidents, and preparing monitoring reports and reassessment checklists for day-to-day oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own, operate, assess, or oversee deployed AI models. It suits people with basic familiarity with model lifecycle or AI governance who need practical post-deployment controls.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with AI or machine-learning model lifecycles, model risk, or AI governance is recommended. Coding is not required; exercises use model monitoring concepts and may use Excel or Power BI for reporting. Advanced drift detection is addressed at an operational application level, not as technical model implementation.
